intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered for two. Watch the sun melt into the horizon while sipping champagne and enjoying a curated platter of local and international canapés. A quintessential romantic experience perfect for honeymooners.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore vibrant coral gardens teeming with manta rays, sea turtles, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish. A guided snorkeling safari takes you to three of the best reef spots in the atoll, with a marine biologist on board to narrate the underwater world. Equipment and light refreshments included.

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two
experiences.description: Indulge in a couples' massage and spa ritual inside a stunning semi-submerged glass spa pavilion surrounded by the ocean. Treatments incorporate traditional Maldivian ingredients like coconut oil, sea salt, and tropical botanicals. An ultra-luxurious experience designed for honeymooners seeking ultimate relaxation.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience
experiences.description: Be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded, uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the ocean. A personal butler and chef set up a romantic table for two with fresh Maldivian seafood, grilled lobster, tropical fruits, and chilled wine. Swim, snorkel, and sunbathe in complete privacy before and after your meal.
experiences.location: Veligandu Sandbank, North Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Visit the historic capital island of Malé and explore its colorful fish market, the 17th-century Hukuru Miskiy coral stone mosque, and local artisan workshops. End the experience with a hands-on Maldivian cooking class where you learn to prepare traditional dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and coconut roshi flatbread.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Visit the historic capital island of Malé and explore its colorful fish market, the 17th-century Hukuru Miskiy coral stone mosque, and local artisan workshops. End the experience with a hands-on Maldivian cooking class where you learn to prepare traditional dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and coconut roshi flatbread.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - flight arrives at 22:30
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled - in transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30. Clear immigration and customs, collect luggage. Arrange speedboat or ferry transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, freshen up, and do a quick orientation of the resort beachfront area under the stars.

meals.breakfast: On the flight
meals.lunch: On the flight or at airport
meals.dinner: Light snack from the resort welcome amenity or grab a quick bite at the airport before departure to resort (~$5-10 USD)

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange your transfer to the resort before arrival to save time and money. Many budget resorts offer shared speedboat transfers which are significantly cheaper than private ones. Keep your carry-on essentials accessible as it may be midnight by the time you reach your room. Exchange a small amount of currency at the airport for tips and local purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and recover from travel. After a leisurely wake-up, enjoy a walk along the beachfront of Aegean Bliss Resort. Explore the resort grounds, locate key amenities (snorkeling gear rental desk, dining areas, water sports center), and take in your first stunning views of the turquoise lagoon. Dip your toes in the Indian Ocean for the first time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent basic snorkeling gear from the resort (~$10-15/day) and explore the house reef directly accessible from the beach. The Maldives house reef is teeming with colorful parrotfish, clownfish, and coral gardens. No boat needed — just wade in from the shore. Spend 2-3 hours discovering the underwater world at your own pace.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the legendary Maldivian sunset from the beachfront. Stroll along the shoreline and collect shells. Head to the resort's casual beach bar for a budget-friendly mocktail or local soft drink while the sky turns pink and orange.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet (included if part of your package) or order à la carte eggs and toast (~$8-12 USD)
meals.lunch: Pack a simple picnic from the resort's grab-and-go counter or enjoy a light sandwich at the beach café (~$10-15 USD)
meals.dinner: Dine at the resort's main restaurant — opt for the local Maldivian fish curry with rice, which is typically the most affordable and most authentic option (~$15-20 USD)

day_by_day.notes: Day 2 is your orientation and relaxation day. Don't over-plan. The house reef snorkeling is completely free once you have gear and is often just as spectacular as paid excursions. Ask resort staff about the best times to spot sea turtles at the house reef — usually early morning or late afternoon.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early (around 6:00 AM) for a sunrise snorkeling session at the house reef when the water is calmest and marine life is most active. Look out for reef sharks, rays, and vibrant coral formations. Return for a proper breakfast and then relax on your beachfront accommodation's private stretch of sand.
day_by_day.afternoon: Book the Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class excursion. Visit the historic capital island of Malé, explore its colorful fish market, and see the 17th-century Hukuru Miskiy (Friday Mosque). Learn about local Maldivian traditions and participate in a hands-on cooking class learning to prepare traditional dishes like Garudhiya (fish broth) and Mas Huni (tuna and coconut). This is a budget-friendly cultural experience that gives deep insight into authentic Maldivian life.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by early evening. Apply what you learned in the cooking class by recreating the flavors at dinner. Enjoy a romantic beachside dinner at the resort, requesting a table closest to the water's edge for a honeymoon-worthy atmosphere.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — fresh tropical fruits, yogurt, and local flatbread (~$8-12 USD or included)
meals.lunch: Included as part of the Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class — enjoy authentic Maldivian food you helped prepare
meals.dinner: Resort beachfront dining — grilled fresh catch of the day with local vegetables (~$18-22 USD). Ask for the 'local menu' which is typically more affordable than the international menu.

day_by_day.notes: The Cultural Village Tour is one of the best value experiences in the Maldives, combining history, culture, and a meal. Book at least 24 hours in advance through the resort's activities desk. Wear comfortable walking shoes and lightweight clothing for the Malé visit. Bring sunscreen and a reusable water bottle.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning dolphin watching excursion — book a shared group boat trip through the resort activities desk (~$25-35 USD per person for a shared trip). Spinner dolphins are commonly spotted in Maldivian waters in the early morning. This is a magical, romantic experience perfect for honeymooners.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and spend the afternoon on a self-guided snorkeling adventure. Explore a different section of the house reef, focusing on the deeper drop-off areas where larger fish congregate. Practice underwater photography with your phone in a waterproof case.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a private sandbank picnic sunset experience. Many resorts offer a DIY version where they transport you to a nearby uninhabited sandbank with a picnic basket for a fraction of the cost of formal packages (~$30-50 USD for two). Watch the sun sink into the Indian Ocean from your own private slice of paradise.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the dolphin tour — grab a banana, pastry, and coffee from the resort café (~$5-8 USD)
meals.lunch: Cook your own instant noodles in your room or grab a local-style tuna sandwich from the resort's casual outlet (~$8-10 USD) to save budget
meals.dinner: Splurge slightly for the sandbank picnic experience — pre-packed sandwiches, fruit, and local snacks provided (~$15-20 USD per person)

day_by_day.notes: The sandbank picnic is one of the most romantic and iconic Maldives experiences and doesn't have to be expensive if you negotiate a simple version with resort staff. Bring mosquito repellent for the evening sandbank visit. The dolphin watching trip is weather-dependent — have a backup plan.

day_by_day.morning: Explore the local inhabited island nearest to your resort (ask resort staff for recommendations and ferry schedules). Walk through the local village, visit the island's small mosque, browse local shops selling handmade lacquerwork, woven mats, and carved wooden crafts. Chat with friendly locals and experience authentic island life far removed from resort luxury.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the local island's beach — often less crowded and just as beautiful as resort beaches. Bring your own snorkeling gear and explore the reef around the local island. Many local island reefs are pristine and rarely visited by tourists. Pick up affordable local snacks from a small convenience store.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for the evening. Enjoy a slow, romantic walk along the beachfront as night falls. Look up — the Maldives has virtually zero light pollution, making stargazing extraordinary. Lie on the beach and identify constellations together.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast (~$8-12 USD or included)
meals.lunch: Eat at a local teashop (sai hotel) on the inhabited island — this is the most authentic and cheapest dining in the Maldives. A full meal of short eats (hedhika), fish curry, and tea costs less than $5-8 USD
meals.dinner: Resort dinner — try the Maldivian BBQ night if available, or order fresh grilled lobster which, paradoxically, can be quite affordable at local resort restaurants (~$20-25 USD)

day_by_day.notes: Eating at local island teashops (sai hotels) is the single best way to save money on food in the Maldives while experiencing authentic cuisine. Always carry small USD bills or Maldivian Rufiyaa (MVR) for local island purchases. Dress modestly when visiting inhabited islands — cover shoulders and knees out of respect for local Islamic customs.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicated snorkeling day — join a shared group snorkeling boat trip to visit 2-3 different reef sites around the atoll (~$30-45 USD per person for a shared half-day trip). These trips visit sites inaccessible from shore, including coral gardens, overhangs, and channels where manta rays and reef sharks are commonly seen.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return from snorkeling and rest. Spend the afternoon reading on the beach, napping in a hammock, or simply floating in the warm lagoon. The Maldives invites you to do absolutely nothing — embrace it. This is the luxury of time, which costs nothing.
day_by_day.evening: Arrange a couple's spa treatment at the resort spa. Look for budget spa packages or 'happy hour' discounts which many resorts offer in the late afternoon (~$40-60 USD for a 60-minute couples massage). This is a romantic honeymoon indulgence worth the splurge.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast (~$8-12 USD or included)
meals.lunch: Snacks and fruit brought from the resort on the snorkeling boat — pack your own to avoid expensive on-boat purchases
meals.dinner: Light dinner at the resort's casual beachside café — fish and chips or a simple pasta (~$12-18 USD)

day_by_day.notes: Always compare prices for snorkeling excursions — booking through the resort is convenient but often 20-30% more expensive than booking directly with local dive/snorkel operators on nearby inhabited islands. Ask your resort if they can connect you with local operators. The spa 'happy hour' deals are rarely advertised — always ask at the spa reception.

day_by_day.morning: Mid-trip rest and reflection morning. Sleep in, enjoy a slow breakfast, and write postcards or journal entries about the trip so far. Take a long swim in the lagoon and practice free-diving techniques to get closer to the coral and fish during snorkeling.
day_by_day.afternoon: DIY kayaking adventure — rent a kayak from the resort water sports center (~$10-15/hour) and paddle around the lagoon, exploring the edges of the reef and nearby sandbars. Kayaking gives you access to shallow areas that boats cannot reach and is a wonderfully peaceful way to explore.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic in-room or private beach dinner setup. Many resorts offer a 'private beach dinner' experience that sounds expensive but can be negotiated to a simple setup — a table on the sand, candles, and the regular menu — for a minimal surcharge (~$20-30 extra). Perfect for a honeymoon celebration.

meals.breakfast: Splurge on a full resort breakfast buffet to celebrate the halfway point of your trip (~$15-20 USD or included)
meals.lunch: Picnic on the kayak — pack sandwiches and fruit from the resort grab-and-go counter
meals.dinner: Private beach dinner setup with the resort's regular menu — fresh seafood platter for two (~$40-60 USD total, a romantic splurge)

day_by_day.notes: Day 7 is a great day to celebrate your honeymoon with a special dinner. Negotiate the private beach setup in advance and mention it's your honeymoon — resorts often add complimentary touches like flower petals or a small cake at no extra charge. Kayaking is best in the morning or late afternoon when winds are calmer.

day_by_day.morning: Take a shared ferry or local speedboat to a nearby uninhabited island for the day (~$10-20 USD per person round trip). Spend the morning exploring the pristine, completely deserted beach — collect shells, explore the interior vegetation, and enjoy having an entire island to yourselves.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkel around the uninhabited island's reef — often these reefs are in better condition than those near resort islands due to less foot traffic. Look for sea turtles, which frequently rest on the reefs around uninhabited islands. Pack your own lunch and enjoy a true castaway experience.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Rinse off and head to the resort's overwater bar (if available) or beachfront lounge for sundowner drinks. Watch the green flash phenomenon at sunset — a rare optical effect sometimes visible on clear horizon sunsets.

meals.breakfast: Early resort breakfast before the island trip (~$8-12 USD or included)
meals.lunch: Self-packed picnic — prepare the night before using resort grab-and-go items: sandwiches, fruit, nuts, and plenty of water (~$10-15 USD)
meals.dinner: Resort dinner — try a different restaurant or dining venue within the resort to keep things fresh (~$15-20 USD)

day_by_day.notes: Check ferry and boat schedules the day before to plan your uninhabited island day trip. Bring everything you need — sunscreen, water, snacks, first aid kit — as there are no facilities on uninhabited islands. Leave no trace — pack out all your rubbish. The Maldives ecosystem is extremely fragile.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga or meditation on the beach — many resorts offer complimentary or low-cost morning yoga sessions on the beach at sunrise. This is a beautiful, peaceful way to start the day with your partner. If the resort doesn't offer it, simply practice your own stretching routine on the sand as the sun rises.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's water sports center for a budget-friendly introduction to stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) — typically ~$15-20/hour for rental. SUP is easy to learn, great exercise, and gives you a unique elevated perspective of the crystal-clear water below. Challenge each other to see who can stay on longest.
day_by_day.evening: Explore the resort's reef at night with a guided night snorkeling tour (~$20-30 USD per person). The reef transforms after dark — bioluminescent plankton, sleeping fish, hunting octopuses, and nocturnal creatures create a completely different underwater world. An unforgettable romantic experience.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast before yoga — fresh fruit, yogurt, and green tea (~$8-10 USD or included)
meals.lunch: Resort beach grill — freshly grilled fish skewers and salad (~$12-15 USD)
meals.dinner: Early dinner before the night snorkeling tour — keep it light with a local fish soup and rice (~$10-15 USD)

day_by_day.notes: Night snorkeling is one of the most magical and underrated experiences in the Maldives. Book in advance as spots are limited. The bioluminescent plankton (sea fireflies) that sometimes light up the water at night is a natural phenomenon — ask locals or resort staff if conditions are right during your stay. Best seen on moonless nights.

day_by_day.morning: Revisit your favorite snorkeling spot from the trip — whether the house reef, the uninhabited island reef, or a boat excursion site. By now you know the reef well and will spot things you missed before. Bring an underwater notebook to sketch the fish and coral you identify.
day_by_day.afternoon: Crafts and souvenirs afternoon — visit the resort's gift shop and compare prices with items you saw on the local inhabited island earlier in the trip. Purchase meaningful, locally-made souvenirs: lacquerwork boxes, woven palm leaf items, or hand-painted shells. Budget ~$20-40 USD for souvenirs to bring home.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a Bodu Beru (traditional Maldivian drumming) cultural performance if offered at the resort or on a nearby island. This traditional music and dance performance is deeply rooted in Maldivian culture and often offered free or at low cost at resort cultural nights. An authentic and energetic experience.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast (~$8-12 USD or included)
meals.lunch: Try making your own Maldivian-inspired meal in your room if you have kitchen facilities, using ingredients from the local island market — fresh tuna, coconut, and flatbread (~$5-8 USD)
meals.dinner: Cultural night dinner at the resort (if available) — often a set menu featuring traditional Maldivian dishes accompanying the Bodu Beru performance (~$20-25 USD)

day_by_day.notes: Bodu Beru performances are typically held on Friday or Saturday evenings. Confirm the schedule with resort staff early in the week. When buying souvenirs, always negotiate politely — prices are often flexible, especially when buying multiple items. Authentic locally-made crafts are far more meaningful than mass-produced items.

day_by_day.morning: Final dedicated snorkeling morning — wake up at dawn for the absolute best conditions: calm water, low boat traffic, and the most active marine life. Spend 2-3 hours doing a thorough exploration of the entire house reef, making a mental checklist of every species you've spotted during the trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relaxation and pampering afternoon. Use the resort pool (if available) or simply float in the lagoon. Read, nap, and recharge. Begin thinking about packing and organizing your belongings. Take final photos of the resort, your beachfront room, and the stunning views you'll want to remember forever.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset dhoni (traditional Maldivian wooden boat) cruise — book a shared sunset cruise on a traditional dhoni boat (~$25-35 USD per person). Sail across the lagoon as the sun sets, sipping on fresh coconut water, watching the sky change colors. A deeply romantic and quintessentially Maldivian experience.

meals.breakfast: Early snorkeling fuel — grab a banana, energy bar, and coffee before heading to the reef (~$5-8 USD)
meals.lunch: Resort lunch — treat yourself to a slightly more indulgent meal as the trip winds down (~$15-20 USD)
meals.dinner: Sunset dhoni cruise may include light snacks. Follow with a relaxed resort dinner featuring your favorite dishes from the trip (~$15-20 USD)

day_by_day.notes: Day 11 is about savoring every last moment. Take your time on the reef and really absorb the experience. The sunset dhoni cruise is a perfect penultimate evening activity — it encapsulates everything magical about the Maldives. Tip the dhoni crew if you enjoyed the experience (~$5-10 USD is appreciated).

day_by_day.morning: Final morning snorkel — one last dip in the house reef to say goodbye to the fish and coral that have been your companions throughout the trip. Take underwater videos to share with friends and family. Collect a small jar of sand from the beach as a free, meaningful souvenir.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check-out preparation — pack bags, settle the resort bill, and review all charges carefully. Return any rented equipment (snorkel gear, kayaks). Take a final walk around the entire resort, revisiting your favorite spots. Have a long, final swim in the lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at the resort — order your absolute favorite meal from the trip. Dress up slightly to mark the occasion. Watch the final Maldivian sunset together from the beach. Write a review of the resort and your favorite experiences while memories are fresh. Arrange your transfer to the airport for the following day.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast (~$8-12 USD or included)
meals.lunch: Light lunch — save appetite for the farewell dinner (~$8-10 USD)
meals.dinner: Farewell splurge dinner — order your favorites from the trip, perhaps fresh lobster or a seafood platter with local sides and a celebratory mocktail (~$30-40 USD for two)

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your airport transfer booking for the next day — timing, pickup location, and cost. If flying out late on Day 13, ask about late checkout options (sometimes free, sometimes a small fee). Settle your resort bill the evening before departure to avoid morning rush. Keep travel documents and flight details easily accessible.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for one final sunrise on the Maldivian beach — this is a moment you'll carry with you forever. Take a last swim, breathe in the salt air, and sit quietly on the sand. Pack any remaining items and do a thorough room check (under beds, in safe, chargers behind furniture).
day_by_day.afternoon: Depart for Velana International Airport via pre-arranged resort transfer. Arrive at the airport with plenty of time (2-3 hours before international flights). Browse duty-free shops for last-minute gifts — Maldivian honey, dried tuna (Maldive fish), and local spice blends make authentic, affordable gifts (~$10-20 USD). Clear security and immigration.
day_by_day.evening: Board your flight home, carrying with you memories of turquoise lagoons, vibrant coral reefs, starlit nights on the beach, and the warm hospitality of the Maldivian people. Begin planning your return.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast or room-service coffee and pastry (~$8-12 USD or included)
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or café — keep it simple and budget-friendly (~$10-15 USD)
meals.dinner: On the flight home

day_by_day.notes: Total estimated budget for the 13-day trip (excluding flights and accommodation): Snorkeling gear rental ($130-195), Excursions and activities ($200-300), Meals beyond included breakfast ($300-450), Local transport ($50-80), Souvenirs and shopping ($50-100), Spa and special experiences ($80-120). Grand total approximately $810-$1,245 USD for two people over 13 days, making this a genuinely budget-conscious Maldives honeymoon. The key savings come from eating local, booking shared excursions, using the house reef, and visiting inhabited islands.

trip_options.description: The sweet spot between comfort and value. Enjoy quality accommodations, diverse experiences, and good food.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight in transit
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — flight in transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Complete immigration and customs. Meet Aegean Bliss Resort transfer representative and board the resort speedboat or seaplane transfer to the resort. Check in, receive a welcome drink and cold towel, and settle into your Beachfront accommodation.

meals.breakfast: On-board flight meal
meals.lunch: On-board flight meal
meals.dinner: Light late-night welcome snack platter provided by Aegean Bliss Resort upon check-in — tropical fruits, local sweet bread (roshi), and fresh juice

day_by_day.notes: Late arrival — keep luggage organized for quick unpacking. Confirm speedboat/seaplane transfer details with resort in advance. Rest is the priority tonight. Do not schedule early activities for Day 2 morning to allow recovery from travel.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a slow, relaxed start. Take a leisurely stroll along your private beachfront, dip your toes in the turquoise lagoon, and get acquainted with the resort layout. Visit the resort's activity desk to pre-book experiences for the week.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the resort pool or beachfront for a relaxing afternoon. Explore the house reef with snorkeling gear provided by the resort — spot colorful reef fish, corals, and possibly sea turtles right from the shore. Perfect gentle introduction to the underwater world.
day_by_day.evening: Watch your first Maldivian sunset from the beach with cocktails in hand. Enjoy a romantic candlelit dinner at the resort's main over-water or beachside restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the resort's main restaurant — fresh tropical fruits, eggs made to order, pastries, local Maldivian breakfast items like mas huni (tuna and coconut) and roshi flatbread
meals.lunch: Casual lunch at the resort's beach grill/bar — grilled fish sandwich, fresh salads, coconut water
meals.dinner: Romantic à la carte dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort's signature restaurant — grilled lobster or fresh catch of the day, paired with a glass of house wine (mid-range menu selection)

day_by_day.notes: This is a gentle recovery and orientation day. Confirm bookings for the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari and Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise at the activity desk. Pick up a resort map and ask staff about the best house reef snorkeling spots and tide timings.

day_by_day.morning: Join the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari — depart by resort boat to vibrant coral gardens teeming with manta rays, sea turtles, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish. Guided by a certified marine biologist, explore two to three distinct coral sites across the atoll. Snorkeling equipment provided.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to resort by midday. Relax on your beachfront with a good book or take a nap in the hammock. Optional: visit the resort's spa for a solo relaxation treatment or foot massage to unwind after the morning activity.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — board a traditionally decorated Maldivian dhoni boat privately chartered just for the two of you. Sail across the Indian Ocean as the sun melts into the horizon, sipping chilled champagne and enjoying canapes. A truly romantic and iconic Maldivian experience.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort — fresh juices, tropical fruits, eggs station, local Maldivian items
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort beach bar — grilled prawn skewers, Caesar salad, fresh coconut
meals.dinner: Dinner back at the resort after the dhoni cruise — choose the casual open-air terrace restaurant for a relaxed meal; grilled mahi-mahi or chicken curry with steamed rice and local roshi bread

day_by_day.notes: The Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari typically departs early morning around 8:00–9:00 AM to catch the best light and marine activity. Apply reef-safe sunscreen only. The Sunset Dhoni Cruise departs approximately 90 minutes before sunset — confirm exact timing with the resort activity desk based on the day's sunset time.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a peaceful morning yoga session on the beach (offered by the resort) as the sun rises over the lagoon. Afterward, take a kayak or stand-up paddleboard out on the glassy morning water — equipment available through the resort's water sports center at no or minimal extra cost.
day_by_day.afternoon: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two — indulge in a couples' massage and spa ritual inside the resort's stunning semi-submerged glass spa pavilion surrounded by the ocean. Choose from a signature Maldivian coconut and sea salt scrub followed by a hot stone massage. A deeply romantic and rejuvenating experience.
day_by_day.evening: Stroll hand-in-hand along the beach as the stars emerge. Enjoy cocktails at the resort's overwater bar before heading to dinner. Tonight, try the resort's themed cuisine night if available (often Asian or Mediterranean nights at mid-range resorts).

meals.breakfast: Healthy breakfast at the resort — açaí bowls, granola, fresh fruit, green smoothies, and eggs to order
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch — club sandwich, fresh fruit platter, iced tea or mocktail
meals.dinner: Resort themed dinner night or à la carte — seafood pasta, grilled barramundi, or a shared mezze board; pair with a carafe of house white wine

day_by_day.notes: Book the Underwater Spa Treatment for Two well in advance as it is one of the most popular experiences and slots fill quickly. The spa pavilion experience is best in the early-to-mid afternoon when the light filters beautifully through the glass panels. Arrive 15 minutes early to enjoy the pre-treatment relaxation lounge.

day_by_day.morning: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour and Cooking Class — depart by speedboat to the historic capital island of Malé. Explore the colorful fish market bustling with the morning's fresh catch, visit the 17th-century Hukuru Miskiy (Old Friday Mosque) built from coral stone, and wander through local streets discovering Maldivian daily life and crafts.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the Cultural Tour with a hands-on Maldivian cooking class — learn to prepare traditional dishes such as garudhiya (tuna broth), mas riha (fish curry), and fresh roshi flatbread using authentic spices and techniques guided by a local chef. Enjoy what you cook as your lunch.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by speedboat in the late afternoon. Freshen up and enjoy a quiet, romantic evening — sit on your private beachfront terrace with a bottle of wine watching the stars reflect on the calm ocean.

meals.breakfast: Early buffet breakfast at the resort before departure for Malé
meals.lunch: Lunch is included as part of the Maldivian Cooking Class — you eat the authentic dishes you prepare: garudhiya, fish curry, roshi, and fresh coconut sambol
meals.dinner: Casual in-resort dinner at the beach grill — fresh grilled snapper, vegetable stir-fry, jasmine rice, and a shared dessert of coconut panna cotta

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly when visiting Malé and the Old Mosque — shoulders and knees should be covered out of respect. This is a fantastic cultural contrast to the pure relaxation days and highly recommended for curious travelers. The cooking class is interactive and fun even for non-cooks. Confirm departure time with the resort as boat schedules to Malé vary.

day_by_day.morning: Free morning for pure relaxation — sleep in, enjoy breakfast in bed (order room service for a special treat), then lounge on your private beachfront. Take a gentle swim in the crystal-clear lagoon and enjoy the peace of a quieter resort morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience — be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded, uninhabited sandbank rising from the middle of the Indian Ocean. A personal butler and chef have set up a beautifully decorated picnic with fresh seafood, chilled wines, tropical fruits, and artisan desserts. Swim, snorkel, and sunbathe on your own private island.
day_by_day.evening: Return to resort in the late afternoon, sun-kissed and blissful. Enjoy a light evening — sundowner cocktails at the overwater bar, then a relaxed dinner at the resort.

meals.breakfast: Room service breakfast in bed — eggs Benedict, fresh fruit bowl, croissants, fresh-pressed juice, and coffee (small extra charge for room service but worth the romance)
meals.lunch: Fully included as part of the Private Sandbank Picnic — curated menu of fresh grilled lobster, sashimi, tropical salads, artisan bread, chilled Champagne, and dessert
meals.dinner: Light dinner at the resort — wood-fired pizza or a shared charcuterie and cheese board with a glass of red wine at the casual terrace restaurant

day_by_day.notes: The Private Sandbank Picnic is the crown jewel of romantic Maldivian experiences — book as early as possible. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, and sunglasses as there is zero shade on a sandbank. The experience typically lasts 3–4 hours. Tides can affect sandbank accessibility so the resort will confirm the best time of day.

day_by_day.morning: Mid-trip rest and reflection day. Enjoy a slow morning — take a sunrise walk along the full perimeter of the island, do some light stretching or meditation on the beach, then have a leisurely breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort's marine center and join a guided house reef snorkeling session led by the resort's marine biologist. Learn about coral restoration efforts and spot different species of fish, eels, and sea turtles. Alternatively, try a beginner's scuba diving discovery session if you've never dived before (available at most Maldivian resorts for mid-range cost).
day_by_day.evening: Romantic evening walk on the beach under the stars. The Maldives offers some of the world's best stargazing due to minimal light pollution — look out for bioluminescent plankton glowing blue in the waves after dark (seasonal but common in the Maldives).

meals.breakfast: Leisurely buffet breakfast at the resort — take your time, try everything, enjoy multiple coffees
meals.lunch: Beachside lunch — fish tacos, fresh mango salsa, cold pressed juice, and a shared dessert
meals.dinner: Special mid-trip romantic dinner — book a table at the resort's premium over-water restaurant; try the tasting menu or chef's special of the day with paired wines (slightly higher spend but appropriate mid-trip splurge)

day_by_day.notes: Day 7 marks the halfway point of your trip — a great time to reflect, relax, and plan any remaining experiences you want to add. Ask the resort about bioluminescent plankton activity — it is most visible on dark, calm nights and creates a magical, unforgettable romantic moment on the beach.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning fishing excursion — join a traditional Maldivian line fishing trip on a local dhoni boat. Fish at sunrise using traditional hand-line techniques alongside local fishermen. A wonderfully authentic and peaceful experience with spectacular early morning light.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to resort with your catch. Spend the afternoon at leisure — lounge by the pool, enjoy the resort's complimentary non-motorized water sports (kayaking, snorkeling, paddleboarding), or simply nap in a shaded beach cabana.
day_by_day.evening: Attend the resort's weekly cultural evening if available — Maldivian traditional music (bodu beru drumming) and dance performance on the beach, often accompanied by a seafood barbecue buffet. A lively and memorable evening.

meals.breakfast: Light early breakfast before the fishing trip — grab a banana, yogurt, and coffee from the resort's early riser station
meals.lunch: Ask the resort chef to cook your morning catch for lunch — a truly farm-to-table (ocean-to-table) experience; served simply grilled with lemon, herbs, and a side salad
meals.dinner: Resort beach barbecue buffet (cultural evening) — grilled seafood, Maldivian curries, fresh salads, tropical desserts; live bodu beru drumming performance included

day_by_day.notes: The fishing excursion typically departs very early (5:30–6:30 AM) to catch the best fishing conditions at dawn — confirm timing the evening before. If the resort does not have a cultural evening on this date, ask the activity desk which night it falls on and adjust accordingly. The bodu beru performance is a highlight — don't miss it.

day_by_day.morning: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari — second visit with a focus on different sites you haven't explored yet. This time, venture further to see manta ray cleaning stations or whale shark hotspots if in season (March is an excellent month for whale shark sightings in the Maldives). Bring an underwater camera or rent a GoPro from the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to resort for a relaxed afternoon. Visit the resort boutique to browse Maldivian crafts, jewelry, and souvenirs. Alternatively, enjoy a solo spa treatment — a deep tissue massage or traditional Maldivian herbal oil treatment to soothe muscles after snorkeling.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails on your private beachfront terrace — order a bottle of sparkling wine from room service and watch the sun set from your own slice of paradise. Intimate, private, and utterly romantic.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort — fuel up well before the snorkeling safari
meals.lunch: Post-snorkeling lunch at the resort beach bar — fresh fish burgers, sweet potato fries, and fresh lime soda
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's casual terrace restaurant — Maldivian-style fish curry with coconut rice, vegetable sambol, and fresh roshi; finish with a local sweet dessert of bondi (sweet rice balls)

day_by_day.notes: March is peak season for whale shark sightings around South Ari Atoll — ask the resort's marine team if they have received any recent sightings and request to be included on the whale shark alert list. Whale shark snorkeling is a life-changing experience and well worth prioritizing if the opportunity arises. Reef-safe sunscreen is mandatory.

day_by_day.morning: Dolphin watching excursion — join a resort-organized morning boat trip to spot spinner dolphins, which are abundant in the Maldives and often leap playfully alongside the boat. A joyful and exhilarating experience best enjoyed in the early morning hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to resort. Enjoy a slow, indulgent afternoon — order a poolside cocktail, lie in the sun, and do absolutely nothing. This is the Maldives — sometimes the best activity is pure, uninterrupted relaxation.
day_by_day.evening: Second Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise — if you loved the first one, consider a second booking, or simply enjoy a sunset walk along the beach followed by a romantic dinner. Alternatively, try the resort's overwater bar for sunset drinks with live acoustic music if available.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the dolphin excursion — fresh fruit, yogurt parfait, and coffee
meals.lunch: Beachside lunch — grilled chicken wrap with avocado, mixed greens salad, fresh watermelon juice
meals.dinner: Romantic dinner at the resort's over-water restaurant — choose the fresh catch of the day prepared your preferred way (grilled, pan-seared, or baked in banana leaf Maldivian style); share a dessert of warm chocolate lava cake with vanilla ice cream

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin watching is best in the early morning when the sea is calm. Spinner dolphins are most active at sunrise. Bring a camera with a good zoom lens. The afternoon is intentionally free — resist the urge to fill every moment; the Maldives is best savored slowly.

day_by_day.morning: Underwater photography or videography session — rent a GoPro or underwater camera from the resort and spend the morning snorkeling the house reef, capturing memories of the vibrant marine life. Many resorts also offer guided underwater photography sessions with a professional.
day_by_day.afternoon: Revisit the Underwater Spa for a final couples' treatment — choose a different treatment from your first visit such as a Maldivian coconut milk bath ritual for two, a hot stone therapy session, or a revitalizing facial. A perfect way to pamper yourselves before the trip ends.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic beach bonfire evening — ask the resort to arrange a private bonfire on the beach (many resorts offer this as a complimentary or low-cost service). Sit together under the stars with a bottle of wine, watching the flames and listening to the ocean. Pure magic.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast — enjoy every item you haven't tried yet as the trip nears its end
meals.lunch: Light spa-friendly lunch post-treatment — fresh green salad with grilled prawns, detox juice, and fresh fruit
meals.dinner: Private dinner on the beach arranged by the resort — a specially set table on the sand with lanterns, a curated three-course menu, and attentive butler service; an ideal penultimate romantic dinner (mid-range premium option)

day_by_day.notes: Request the beach bonfire and private beach dinner simultaneously for a truly unforgettable evening — the combination of firelight, stars, ocean sounds, and good food is the definition of a perfect Maldives honeymoon night. Book both at least 48 hours in advance. Tip your butler generously for the extra effort.

day_by_day.morning: Final snorkeling session on the house reef — a farewell swim with the turtles, fish, and corals that have been your underwater neighbors for nearly two weeks. Take it slow, say goodbye to the ocean, and soak in every last moment.
day_by_day.afternoon: Begin gentle packing and preparation for departure. Enjoy a final pool afternoon — order a signature cocktail, lie in the sun, and let the peace of the Maldives wash over you one last time. Visit the resort boutique to pick up any final souvenirs, local crafts, or Maldivian spices to bring home.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at the resort's finest restaurant — splurge slightly on this last night. Order something special: whole grilled lobster, a premium wine, and the resort's signature dessert. Toast to an incredible trip and to each other.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely final full buffet breakfast — savor every bite
meals.lunch: Casual beach bar lunch — fish and chips, fresh salad, a final coconut water straight from the shell
meals.dinner: Farewell splurge dinner at the resort's premium restaurant — lobster thermidor or grilled whole fish, premium wine pairing, and a special dessert; ask the resort in advance if they can arrange a 'honeymoon farewell' setup with flowers and a personalized cake

day_by_day.notes: Check out procedures and final transfer arrangements should be confirmed today. Ask the resort concierge about your departure transfer time, luggage storage options if checkout is before your transfer, and whether a late checkout can be arranged for Day 13. Begin consolidating travel documents, passports, and boarding passes.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on the beach — wake early for one last sunrise walk along the shore. Collect a handful of sand or a small shell as a keepsake memory. Enjoy a final breakfast at the resort, savoring the last tastes of paradise.
day_by_day.afternoon: Late morning checkout (request late checkout if your transfer allows). Freshen up, complete packing, and store luggage with the resort concierge. Spend any remaining time at the pool or beach. Board your resort transfer — speedboat or seaplane — back to Velana International Airport with hearts full of memories.
day_by_day.evening: Depart the Maldives. Reflect on 13 extraordinary days of snorkeling, romance, culture, luxury, and pure bliss. Begin the journey home carrying the warmth of the Indian Ocean with you.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — make it count; order your favorites from the entire trip one last time
meals.lunch: Grab a light bite at Velana International Airport — the airport has several dining options including local Maldivian snacks and international fast food for a quick pre-flight meal
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or airport restaurant depending on departure time

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your outbound flight details and transfer timing carefully — Velana International Airport requires you to arrive at least 2–3 hours before international departure. The speedboat transfer from the resort to the airport typically takes 20–45 minutes depending on resort location. Allow ample time. Do not schedule any activities on this day beyond the morning farewell walk and breakfast.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne
experiences.description: Sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditional Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered for two. Watch the sun melt into the horizon while sipping champagne and enjoying a curated platter of local and international canapés. A quintessential romantic experience perfect for honeymooners.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore vibrant coral gardens teeming with manta rays, sea turtles, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish. A guided snorkeling safari takes you to three of the best reef spots in the atoll, with a marine biologist on board to narrate the underwater world. Equipment and light refreshments included.

experiences.name: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two
experiences.description: Indulge in a couples' massage and spa ritual inside a stunning semi-submerged glass spa pavilion surrounded by the ocean. Treatments incorporate traditional Maldivian ingredients like coconut oil, sea salt, and tropical botanicals. An ultra-luxurious experience designed for honeymooners seeking ultimate relaxation.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience
experiences.description: Be whisked away by speedboat to a secluded, uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the ocean. A personal butler and chef set up a romantic table for two with fresh Maldivian seafood, grilled lobster, tropical fruits, and chilled wine. Swim, snorkel, and sunbathe in complete privacy before and after your meal.
experiences.location: Veligandu Sandbank, North Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class
experiences.description: Visit the historic capital island of Malé and explore its colorful fish market, the 17th-century Hukuru Miskiy coral stone mosque, and local artisan workshops. End the experience with a hands-on Maldivian cooking class where you learn to prepare traditional dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and coconut roshi flatbread.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Meet your dedicated Aegean Bliss Resort butler at the private terminal. Transfer via luxury speedboat to the resort (approximately 30–45 minutes). Enjoy a welcome drink and a private late-night arrival orientation. Check into your Beachfront villa, where a rose petal turndown, chilled champagne, and a fruit platter await.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable
meals.lunch: Not applicable
meals.dinner: Private in-villa late-night dining: curated cheese and charcuterie board, tropical fruit platter, and a bottle of Moët & Chandon Champagne arranged by your butler upon arrival

day_by_day.notes: Arrival is at 22:30 — no daytime activities are scheduled. Ensure all pre-arrival requests (pillow menu, dietary preferences, special honeymoon setup) are communicated to the resort in advance. The resort's 24-hour butler service is available from the moment you arrive.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely morning in your Beachfront villa. Take your first private sunrise stroll along the resort's pristine white sand beach. Enjoy a lavish in-villa breakfast served on your private deck overlooking the Indian Ocean, with fresh tropical juices, eggs cooked to order, pastries, and Maldivian roshi with fresh tuna curry.
day_by_day.afternoon: Orientation with your personal butler to plan the week ahead. Explore the resort's facilities — the infinity pool, overwater spa, and beach loungers. Take a complimentary resort snorkel kit and do a casual introductory snorkel directly off the beachfront reef just steps from your villa to get your bearings.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic sunset cocktail hour at the resort's overwater bar, sipping handcrafted cocktails as the sky turns amber and rose. Dinner at the resort's signature fine-dining restaurant — a candlelit table on the beach with the sound of gentle waves.

meals.breakfast: Lavish in-villa breakfast on your private deck — tropical fruit, eggs Benedict, Maldivian roshi with smoked tuna, freshly squeezed juices, and barista coffee
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch at the resort's beach grill — grilled lobster roll, Caesar salad, and fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Signature beachfront fine-dining restaurant at Aegean Bliss Resort — 4-course tasting menu featuring seared yellowfin tuna, pan-roasted sea bass, and a decadent chocolate fondant with passion fruit sorbet; paired with a curated wine selection

day_by_day.notes: Day 2 is intentionally relaxed to allow for jet lag recovery. Request the honeymoon welcome package from your butler if not already arranged — typically includes flower arrangements, a couples' massage voucher, and a bottle of wine.

day_by_day.morning: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari — embark on a guided snorkeling excursion to explore vibrant coral gardens teeming with manta rays, sea turtles, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish. Your expert marine biologist guide will lead you through the most spectacular reef formations in the area. Premium snorkel gear, wetsuits, and underwater cameras are provided.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a poolside lunch. Spend the afternoon at leisure — lounge by the infinity pool, read on the beach, or explore the resort's water sports center. Optional: try stand-up paddleboarding or kayaking in the calm lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — sail across the turquoise Indian Ocean on a traditionally decorated Maldivian dhoni boat, privately chartered exclusively for you. Sip vintage Champagne as the sun melts into the horizon, with canapés and a curated cheese board served on deck by your private crew.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the resort's main restaurant — extensive spread of fresh tropical fruits, live egg station, Maldivian breakfast specialties, smoked salmon, and artisan breads
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch at the resort's beach grill — grilled tiger prawns, watermelon and feta salad, and fresh lime sorbet
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's overwater restaurant — enjoy fresh catch of the day prepared with Maldivian spices, paired with a crisp Sancerre; end with a coconut panna cotta and mango coulis

day_by_day.notes: The Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari is best experienced in the morning when visibility is at its peak and marine life is most active. Sunscreen should be reef-safe — the resort provides complimentary reef-safe sunscreen. The Sunset Dhoni Cruise typically departs around 17:30; confirm exact timing with your butler the evening before.

day_by_day.morning: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two — begin your morning with the resort's most exclusive wellness experience. Indulge in a couples' massage and full spa ritual inside a stunning semi-submerged glass spa pavilion surrounded by the ocean. Watch fish glide past the glass walls as expert therapists perform a 90-minute Balinese massage, followed by a warm coconut oil scalp treatment and a marine mineral body wrap.
day_by_day.afternoon: Post-spa recovery lunch at the resort's health-focused wellness café. Spend the afternoon in pure relaxation — your villa's private plunge pool, hammock on the beach, or a nap in the shade of swaying palms. Optional: book a private yoga session on the beach with the resort's resident yogi.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic dinner under the stars — request a private dining setup on the sandbank just off the resort's beach, with tiki torches, white linen, and a personalized menu prepared by the resort's executive chef. Toast to your honeymoon with a bottle of Dom Pérignon.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — acai bowls, avocado toast, smoked salmon bagels, and a Champagne mimosa to start your spa day right
meals.lunch: Wellness café lunch — cold-pressed green juice, quinoa and roasted vegetable bowl, and a refreshing coconut water
meals.dinner: Private starlit beach dinner — 5-course chef's tasting menu: amuse-bouche, tuna tartare, lobster bisque, grilled reef fish with truffle butter, and a bespoke honeymoon dessert platter with your names written in chocolate

day_by_day.notes: Book the Underwater Spa Treatment well in advance as it is the resort's most sought-after experience and slots are extremely limited. The private beach dinner setup should be arranged at least 48 hours in advance through your butler. A personalized menu can be created based on dietary preferences.

day_by_day.morning: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour & Cooking Class — take a speedboat to the historic capital island of Malé. Explore the colorful fish market at dawn, visit the 17th-century Hukuru Miskiy (Old Friday Mosque) built from coral stone, and wander through the vibrant local streets. Your private guide provides rich historical and cultural context throughout.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the cultural experience with a hands-on Maldivian cooking class. Learn to prepare traditional dishes including mas huni (tuna and coconut salad), garudhiya (fish broth), and bondibai (rice pudding with coconut milk). Enjoy the meal you've prepared together as a shared lunch experience.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by private speedboat. Freshen up and enjoy a quiet evening at the resort's overwater bar for sundowners. Dinner at the resort's Asian fusion restaurant, featuring Japanese and Maldivian-inspired dishes.

meals.breakfast: Early buffet breakfast at the resort before departure — tropical fruits, yogurt parfait, and a strong espresso
meals.lunch: The dishes prepared during the Maldivian cooking class, enjoyed together in a traditional setting on Malé island — mas huni, garudhiya soup, and fresh roshi bread
meals.dinner: Asian fusion restaurant at Aegean Bliss Resort — black truffle edamame, wagyu beef tataki, miso-glazed black cod, and a matcha tiramisu for dessert; sake and Japanese whisky pairing available

day_by_day.notes: The Malé cultural tour departs early (around 07:00) to experience the fish market at its most vibrant. Modest dress is required when visiting the mosque — shoulders and knees should be covered. The resort can provide wraps upon request. This is a wonderful day to purchase authentic Maldivian lacquerwork and woven crafts as souvenirs.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a slow, indulgent morning. Order an elaborate in-villa brunch served on your private deck. Spend the morning swimming in your villa's private plunge pool or lounging on your beachfront terrace with a good book. Optional: request a private stretch and meditation session with the resort's wellness instructor on the beach.
day_by_day.afternoon: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience — be whisked away by private speedboat to a secluded, uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the turquoise ocean. A personal chef and butler have set up a spectacular barefoot luxury picnic with a chilled seafood tower, artisan sandwiches, tropical fruits, and a bottle of rosé Champagne. Swim, snorkel, and sunbathe on your own private island.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort in time for sunset. Enjoy a couples' cocktail-making class at the overwater bar, learning to craft classic Maldivian-inspired cocktails with the resort's head mixologist. Dinner at the resort's beachfront restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Lavish in-villa brunch — eggs Florentine, smoked salmon blinis, tropical fruit platter, croissants with house-made preserves, and freshly brewed pour-over coffee
meals.lunch: Private sandbank picnic — chilled Champagne, fresh oysters, lobster and prawn platter, artisan charcuterie, tropical fruit skewers, and handmade chocolates
meals.dinner: Beachfront restaurant at Aegean Bliss Resort — grilled whole lobster with garlic herb butter, roasted baby vegetables, and a shared warm lava cake with vanilla bean ice cream

day_by_day.notes: The Private Sandbank Picnic is weather-dependent and should be booked with a flexible cancellation policy. Your butler will monitor weather conditions and advise on the best timing. Pack reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, and a light cover-up as shade is minimal on the sandbank.

day_by_day.morning: Second Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari — return to the ocean for a deeper, more adventurous snorkeling experience. Today's safari focuses on a different reef system, with the possibility of encountering whale sharks (seasonal) and large schools of manta rays. Your marine biologist guide tailors the experience to your comfort level and interests.
day_by_day.afternoon: Relax at the resort's private beach club area with reserved sun loungers and personalized cabana service. Enjoy complimentary fruit skewers and cold towels from the beach attendants. Optional: try a resort water sport such as jet skiing, windsurfing, or a glass-bottom kayak tour of the lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Special honeymoon evening — your butler arranges a private overwater bungalow dinner setup with floating floral arrangements, candles, and a personalized menu. Watch the bioluminescent plankton light up the ocean around you as you dine under a canopy of stars.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at the main restaurant — focus on energy-boosting foods before snorkeling: fresh fruit, granola, protein-rich eggs, and green smoothies
meals.lunch: Beach club cabana service — lobster club sandwich, fresh papaya salad, and a frozen passion fruit daiquiri
meals.dinner: Private overwater dinner — 6-course honeymoon tasting menu: caviar amuse-bouche, chilled gazpacho, seared scallops, mango and burrata salad, pan-seared reef fish, and a bespoke honeymoon cake with sparklers

day_by_day.notes: Week one midpoint — check in with your butler to confirm bookings for the second half of the trip and make any adjustments. The bioluminescent plankton experience is best viewed after 21:00 when the sky is fully dark. Ask your butler to arrange a short guided walk to the water's edge to witness this natural phenomenon.

day_by_day.morning: Sunrise yoga and meditation session on a private overwater platform with the resort's certified yoga instructor. Breathe in the ocean air and greet the day with gentle sun salutations as the sky turns gold. Follow with a refreshing dip in the ocean directly from the platform.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in individual spa treatments at the resort's overwater spa — choose from a deep tissue massage, hot stone therapy, or a traditional Ayurvedic treatment. Spend the remaining afternoon hours at the spa's relaxation lounge with herbal teas and healthy snacks.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the resort's signature overwater bar, followed by a themed dinner night — the resort's weekly Maldivian Night features traditional island cuisine, live cultural performances, and Bodu Beru drumming.

meals.breakfast: Post-yoga healthy breakfast at the wellness café — smoothie bowls, chia pudding, fresh coconut, and herbal teas
meals.lunch: Light spa lunch at the spa's private lounge — mezze platter, cold-pressed juices, and raw energy balls
meals.dinner: Maldivian Night buffet — traditional mas riha (fish curry), fihunu mas (grilled fish), garudhiya, fresh roshi, and a dessert spread of bondibaai and dhonkeyo kajuru (banana fritters)

day_by_day.notes: The sunrise yoga session begins at 06:00 — early but deeply rewarding. The Maldivian Night cultural dinner is a resort highlight and typically includes fire dancing and traditional music. Arrive early to secure the best seats near the performance area.

day_by_day.morning: Private dolphin and whale shark spotting excursion — embark on a private chartered boat with an experienced marine guide to search for spinner dolphins and the elusive whale shark in the open waters surrounding the resort. Snorkel alongside these magnificent creatures if encountered (strictly following ethical wildlife guidelines).
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a leisurely afternoon. Explore the resort's boutique for curated Maldivian crafts, jewelry, and luxury resort wear. Enjoy an afternoon tea service at the resort's lounge — finger sandwiches, scones with clotted cream, and a selection of premium teas and Champagne.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise with Champagne — a second sailing experience, this time at a different time of year for slightly different lighting and atmosphere. Tonight's cruise includes a live acoustic guitar performance on deck and a dedicated photographer to capture your honeymoon moments.

meals.breakfast: Early in-villa breakfast before the excursion — tropical fruit, granola, eggs, and strong coffee served by your butler
meals.lunch: Overwater restaurant lunch upon return — sushi and sashimi platter, miso soup, and a light Japanese-style dessert
meals.dinner: Intimate dinner at the resort's fine-dining restaurant — rack of lamb with rosemary jus, truffle mashed potatoes, and a shared chocolate and raspberry fondant; sommelier-paired wine selection

day_by_day.notes: Whale shark encounters are seasonal and not guaranteed — your guide will advise on current sightings. All wildlife encounters follow strict ethical guidelines: no touching, no flash photography, and maintaining a respectful distance. The resort photographer on the Dhoni Cruise can provide edited images within 24 hours.

day_by_day.morning: Underwater Spa Treatment for Two — a second booking of this iconic experience, this time opting for different treatments: a hot stone couples' massage followed by a traditional Javanese lulur body scrub and a hydrating coconut milk bath ritual. A truly indulgent morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon exploring the resort's house reef with a guided snorkel tour led by the resort's resident marine biologist. This session focuses on the resort's coral restoration program — learn how the resort is actively growing and replanting coral to protect the reef ecosystem. Participate in planting a coral fragment as a symbolic act of conservation.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell-style romantic dinner at the resort's most exclusive private dining venue — a table set up on a floating platform in the lagoon, surrounded by lanterns and flowers. A violinist performs softly as you dine under the stars.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — Eggs Benedict with smoked salmon, fresh orange juice, and a Champagne toast to celebrate your honeymoon
meals.lunch: Casual beach picnic arranged by your butler — gourmet sandwiches, fresh fruit, sparkling water, and iced herbal teas delivered to your private beach spot
meals.dinner: Floating platform private dinner — 7-course chef's extravaganza: oysters with mignonette, lobster bisque, foie gras torchon, sorbet intermezzo, Wagyu beef tenderloin, artisan cheese board, and a custom honeymoon dessert creation

day_by_day.notes: The coral planting activity is a meaningful and memorable experience — the resort provides a certificate with the GPS coordinates of your planted coral, which you can track online over the years. The floating platform dinner is the most exclusive dining experience at the resort and must be booked well in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Private Sandbank Picnic Dining Experience — a second visit to the sandbank, this time for a morning experience. Arrive at sunrise and watch the sky transform as you enjoy a private Champagne breakfast on your own island. Snorkel the surrounding waters in the magical morning light.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and spend the afternoon at leisure — final water sports session, last swim in the villa's private plunge pool, or a relaxing afternoon at the pool bar. Optional: book a final individual spa treatment or facial.
day_by_day.evening: Maldivian Cultural Village Tour follow-up — an optional evening visit to a local island village for a traditional community dinner with a local family, arranged privately by the resort. Experience authentic Maldivian hospitality, storytelling, and homemade island cuisine.

meals.breakfast: Private sandbank Champagne breakfast — fresh croissants, tropical fruit, smoked salmon, scrambled eggs in a thermos, and a bottle of vintage Champagne
meals.lunch: Pool bar lunch at the resort — wagyu beef sliders, truffle fries, and a refreshing frozen cocktail
meals.dinner: Traditional Maldivian family dinner on a local island — home-cooked mas riha, fresh roshi, coconut sambal, and sweet bondibaai dessert; a truly authentic and heartwarming experience

day_by_day.notes: The local family dinner experience is arranged through the resort's community partnership program and directly supports local island families. Modest dress is recommended when visiting local islands. This is a beautiful opportunity to connect with Maldivian culture beyond the resort bubble.

day_by_day.morning: Final snorkeling morning — a personal, unguided snorkel session directly off your beachfront villa. Take your time exploring the house reef one last time, saying goodbye to the sea turtles, colorful parrotfish, and swaying coral formations that have become familiar over the past two weeks.
day_by_day.afternoon: Leisurely packing and final villa time. Request a last in-villa Champagne service from your butler. Take a final walk along the beach, collect a small jar of white sand as a keepsake, and photograph your villa and the views you'll treasure forever. Visit the resort boutique for last-minute gifts and souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Grand farewell dinner at the resort's flagship fine-dining restaurant — a special farewell menu curated by the executive chef in your honor, celebrating your honeymoon stay. The resort arranges a surprise dessert with a personalized message and a complimentary bottle of vintage Champagne.

meals.breakfast: Lavish farewell in-villa breakfast — your favorite dishes from the trip, requested in advance through your butler: perhaps Eggs Benedict, fresh tropical fruits, and a final mimosa on the deck
meals.lunch: Casual light lunch at the beach grill — fish tacos, fresh guacamole, and a cold beer or tropical mocktail
meals.dinner: Executive chef's farewell tasting menu — a personalized 8-course culinary journey celebrating the flavors of the Maldives and the Mediterranean: signature dishes, wine pairings, and a bespoke honeymoon dessert to close the trip in style

day_by_day.notes: Request a late checkout if your departure allows — most luxury resorts accommodate this for extended stays. Ask your butler to arrange a resort photo album or USB of professional photos taken throughout your stay as a parting gift. Confirm speedboat transfer timing for the following morning.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise — wake early for one last sunrise on the beach with a private coffee and pastry service set up by your butler on the sand. Watch the sky light up over the Indian Ocean in a moment of quiet reflection and gratitude. Complete final packing and checkout formalities.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depart Aegean Bliss Resort via private luxury speedboat transfer to Velana International Airport. Your dedicated resort butler accompanies you to the water taxi dock and ensures your luggage is handled seamlessly. Arrive at the airport with time to relax in the premium lounge before your flight.
day_by_day.evening: Departure from Maldives — carry with you 13 days of extraordinary memories, a deeper connection, and the promise to return to this paradise.

day_by_day.notes: Ensure all resort charges are reviewed and settled the evening before departure to avoid morning delays. The resort will provide a detailed invoice and can arrange duty-free shopping delivery to the airport. Exchange contact details with your butler — many guests maintain long-term relationships with their Maldivian resort teams. Safe travels and congratulations on your honeymoon!
